objections.objection_text: E91 wrote a new packet into an outbox that was already 54 over the ceiling. The packet documents the graveyard and deepens it in the same act. V2's consumption gate would have refused this write.
objections.resolution_path: Accept as the last V1-shaped packet; under V2 this becomes a triage epoch. No further packets until unconsumed is at or below 30.

objections.objection_text: Two windows are proposed for the same data: E90's get_context_messages(n=20) and E91's get_history(n=20). Applying both double-windows nothing but leaves two knobs for one behaviour.
objections.resolution_path: Apply the window inside get_context_messages() only. Leave get_history() untouched so the replay/reconstruction contract in its docstring stays exact.

objections.objection_text: V2's TARGET CAP tests 'no commit touching its source_refs', but E90 and older packets carry no source_refs field. The rule is not computable for them.
objections.resolution_path: Add a fallback: when source_refs is absent, count epochs only, and freeze at three consecutive packets for the target.

objections.objection_text: The 45 percent figure is honest but measured on backup files. A reader will quote it as a live saving.
objections.resolution_path: Report it as 'on a 36-entry file' and add the scoped test from the packet (50 seeded entries, assert len(context) == 21) as the acceptance metric.

objections.objection_text: Nothing outbox-touching can merge green until the guard passes. HER's ordering (patch first, then V2, then COMMIT) has the CI gate against it: any branch that adds a packet inherits the red check.
objections.resolution_path: Drain first. The operator pen must bring unconsumed to 30 or below before any autoresearch branch can be merged with a green outbox-guard.

reasoning: The findings hold: C-001 and C-003 are reproducible from disk and from the Actions log, and nothing in the diff crosses a sovereign path. What does not hold is HER's sequencing. OBJ-005 is a block because the CI gate, not a preference, decides it: the outbox-guard check is red on main and on this branch, so patch-first cannot merge green. Refine the proposal to drain-first, collapse the two windows into one (OBJ-002), and make the target cap computable (OBJ-003). With those three changes HAL would move to proceed. Verdict on the underlying E91 finding: WARN, not BLOCK; required fixes are on the plan, not on the evidence.
